facts: Absorption maxima are wavelengths of the largest measured molar absorption coefficient, not prescribed TD root numbers.
Compound2 absorption showed no significant change across the source solvent series; the source does not supply a numerical detection threshold for that statement.
measurement_definitions: An experimental absorption maximum, an electronic transition and a frontier-orbital gap are different quantities. Give the spectral or state correspondence used in your comparison.
A molecular electronic interpretation must state the actual electronic states and transition contributions that support it; orbital index labels need not remain the same between different molecules.
public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
